title: Prime Minister congratulates Nitesh Kumar and Pramod Bhagat on their medals at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Nitesh Kumar on winning Gold and Pramod Bhagat on securing Silver in Men’s Singles SL3 at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that this is a wonderful achievement for both athletes, expressing hope that they continue to make the nation proud. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Indian para badminton shines bright! Congratulations to Nitesh Kumar on winning Gold and Pramod Bhagat on securing Silver in Men’s Singles SL3 at the Asian Para Games. A wonderful achievement for both athletes. May they continue to make the nation proud: PM @narendramodi" Indian para badminton shines bright!
